_comment: devkit_mini vendored SI target table - the subset of the researched carrier/research/si_spec.json rows whose pairs the devkit_mini sheets declare (same citations; the targets are interface-standard facts, not board policy).

pairs.notes: PHY (RTL8211F) is on the SoM; carrier carries the 4 MDI pairs from SoM connector → HX5008NLT magnetics (T1) → RJ45. No series AC caps (transformer-isolated). Keep ≥ 30 mil pair-to-pair separation; minimize vias/stubs.
pairs.spec_cite: IEEE 802.3 Clause 40 (1000BASE-T, 100Ω±15% MDI); ANSI/TIA-568 link; PHY-vendor (RTL8211F / TI SNLA387) layout: intra-pair ≤ 50 mil, inter-pair ≤ 50 mm (~330 ps)

pairs.notes: pd_input.py: post-ESD (USBLC6-2SC6 U2) to STM32 USB. DC-coupled. FUSB302B handles CC ESD separately; CC1/CC2 (STM32_USB_CC1/CC2) are low-speed, no diff-pair routing constraint.
pairs.spec_cite: USB 2.0 Spec Sec 7.1.1.3 / 7.1.6 (90Ω±15%); USB-IF HS layout intra-pair ≤150 mil

pairs.notes: Net post-ESD (USBLC6-2SC6 U2 shunt 1↔6/3↔4) to SoM USB HS PHY. NOT AC-coupled (USB2 HS is DC-coupled). Connector pads USBC_DP_CONN/USBC_DM_CONN before ESD; keep stubs to ESD tap short.
pairs.spec_cite: USB 2.0 Spec Sec 7.1.1.3 / 7.1.6 (90Ω±15% differential HS); USB-IF/HS layout: intra-pair ≤150 mil (~1.6 mm), target ≤5 mm

pairs.notes: usb_uart_connector → ESD (USBLC6-2SC6 U1) → CP2102N (uart_bridge U1.3/U1.4). CP2102N is USB 2.0 Full-Speed; honor 90Ω/skew for robustness. DC-coupled.
pairs.spec_cite: USB 2.0 Spec Sec 7.1.1.3 (90Ω±15% diff); USB-IF FS/HS layout intra-pair ≤150 mil
